main_measure.name: mean next-day excess return (close[t+1]/close[t]-1 minus coin's mean daily return) on case bars, same-day cases summed

statistic.name: t of the mean (over per-day summed cases)

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and Spearman > 0; reject: t <= -2

supporting_check.name: Spearman correlation of raw ratio (fall.last_history_value) vs next-day excess return across cases

decided_by: Inconclusive rule met: the t of the mean next-day excess return lies between -2 and 2.
reading: Cases on the same UTC day are summed into one value and the mean and ordinary t are taken over these day sums, the Spearman correlation is taken over individual case bars, the coin's mean daily return is the mean of all its 1-bar returns inside all windows, and the plan's 'fewer than 100 case days' is reported as not observable.
